用VBA為excel自動建立目錄.1:
Sub CreateIndexSheet()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim indexWs As Worksheet
    Dim i As Integer

    ' Check if "Index" sheet already exists
    On Error Resume Next
    Set indexWs = Worksheets("Index")
    On Error GoTo 0

    ' If not, create it
    If indexWs Is Nothing Then
        Set indexWs = Worksheets.Add(Before:=Sheets(1))
        indexWs.Name = "Index"
    Else
        indexWs.Cells.Clear
    End If

    ' Set title
    indexWs.Range("A1").Value = "Sheet Directory:"
    i = 2

    ' Create hyperlinks to each worksheet
    For Each ws In ThisWorkbook.Worksheets
        If ws.Name <> "Index" Then
            With indexWs.Cells(i, 1)
                .Value = ws.Name
                .Hyperlinks.Add Anchor:=indexWs.Cells(i, 1), Address:="", SubAddress:="'" & ws.Name & "'!A1", TextToDisplay:=ws.Name
                .Font.Color = RGB(0, 0, 255)
            End With
            i = i + 1
        End If
    Next ws

    ' Add update button
    Call AddUpdateButton(indexWs)
End Sub

Sub AddUpdateButton(ws As Worksheet)
    Dim btn As Button
    Dim btnExists As Boolean
    Dim shp As Shape

    ' Check if the button already exists
    For Each shp In ws.Shapes
        If shp.Type = msoFormControl Then
            If shp.Name = "btnUpdateIndex" Then
                btnExists = True
                Exit For
            End If
        End If
    Next shp

    If Not btnExists Then
        Set btn = ws.Buttons.Add(200, 10, 100, 30)
        btn.OnAction = "CreateIndexSheet"
        btn.Caption = "Update Index"
        btn.Name = "btnUpdateIndex"
    End If
End Sub
